english.note: Use this for an event or period that lasts only a short time, rather than for concise wording.
Use this when stressing that something lasts only a short time, rather than merely saying that it is not permanent.
This is the all-purpose choice for something that lasts only briefly.
This is the all-purpose choice for something that lasts only a short time, such as a pleasure or feeling.
Use 短暫 for something that lasts only a short time or is momentary.
